context: Customer reported on 2026-10-02 that order ORD-10012 arrived with a torn rain shell. The agent asked for photos. Photos confirmed a tear near the zipper. The warehouse shipped a replacement by express. The customer confirmed receipt on 2026-10-06 and closed the ticket.
A customer was charged twice for order ORD-10031, $142.50 each time. Billing confirmed the duplicate charge. A refund of $142.50 was issued to the original card, expected within 5 business days.
Order ORD-10027 was marked delivered but not received. The courier opened an investigation and after 3 days found the package at a neighbor's address. The customer picked it up and thanked the team.
A member could not redeem 300 Trail Rewards points at checkout. Engineering found a bug in the rewards service, fixed it on 2026-09-18, and granted the member a $15 reward manually.
The customer asked to exchange hiking boots for a size 10, approved because it was within the 30-day window. New boots shipped on 2026-10-11 and the old pair was returned with a prepaid label.
